layout: 6-mic ring, Mono x 6 (receiver moved to each mic, source fixed at the centre)
headings: rel000 = camera forward (rir.npy / rir_binaural.npy, the spec file); binaural also rel090/180/270 = yaw + rel, CCW; the mono ring has no directivity so it is rendered at rel000 only
channel_order: ring angles [pi, 4pi/3, 5pi/3, 2pi, pi/3, 2pi/3] + yaw_h, CCW in the f3loc x,y plane; channel 3 (angle 2pi + yaw_h) points along the heading
source: co-located with the array centre, height 1.50 m above the navmesh
condition_note: watertight proxy extruded floor->ceiling from the same wall mask as map.png (floorplan_proxy/<scene>/floorplan.glb, build_floorplan.py)
